depth_justification: The copilot references some MindCare specifics (Mistral-Large summaries, EU+CH residency, the support-only revocation gap, inconsistent visual labelling) but it loops the same 'therapists skimming' question almost verbatim 4+ times and repeatedly asserts facts the user never gave (e.g. claiming end-to-end encryption, which the user explicitly denied), so it neither tracks the developer's actual data flows nor drills into their stated target users or therapeutic-alliance concern.
actionability_justification: Most turns are restated observations plus a generic 'given the sensitive nature of mental health data' suffix rather than concrete steps; only the final report offers implementable specifics (one-tap revocation, mandatory full-entry confirmation prompt) tied to named articles, but several article mappings are loose or wrong (pen-test mapped to GDPR Art. 30 Record of Processing), keeping it at directional rather than recipe-grade.
